title: Cantaloupe Melon Custard Ice Cream
changes_from_base: Raw blended cantaloupe whisked into a four-yolk custard; the source is an eggless melon ice cream, adapted to our custard base.
summary: Our classic custard made lighter and fruitier: very ripe cantaloupe is blended raw and whisked into a four-yolk custard. Fresh, delicate and summery.

ingredients.item: very ripe cantaloupe flesh, rind and seeds removed, cubed
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Make the custard
steps.text: Heat the cream and milk until steaming. Whisk the yolks, sugar and salt until pale, whisk in a third of the hot dairy and pour it back into the pan.

steps.title: Cook and chill
steps.text: Cook, stirring, over low heat until it reaches 77-80 °C and thickens slightly. Strain, cool in the iced water and chill for at least 4 h.

steps.title: Purée the melon
steps.text: Scrub the melon skin well before cutting it. Blend the flesh with the lemon juice until liquid, then chill.

steps.title: Combine
steps.text: Whisk the cold melon purée into the cold custard.

steps.title: Churn and freeze
steps.text: Churn; it will stay quite soft. Freeze for 3-4 h until scoopable.

tips: The melon must be very ripe and fragrant; smell the stem end before buying.
A common mistake is mixing the purée into warm custard, which dulls the fresh flavour.
If it has been frozen longer, soften it in the fridge for 30 min before serving.
storage: Freeze, covered, for up to 1 week; the melon flavour fades after that.
